summary:
COMPLETE — all 57 target municipalities investigated. 33 have a genuine public directory (city page or regional 211/CIOC system), 18 have no directory found ('none-found' — a real finding, not a search failure), 5 have a directory that is currently a dead link/broken (404 or Cloudflare error, still indexed by search engines), and 1 (Ottawa) has a real basketball directory page sitting behind an Incapsula bot-wall that was NOT bypassed per instructions. 62 organizations harvested: 46 have an email, 23 have a phone, 20 have both, 24 have a named contact person — 49 of 62 (79%) have at least one direct contact channel beyond a bare website.

BIGGEST INFRASTRUCTURE FINDING: several Ontario regions publish their municipal 'community organization' directory through the 211/OpenCIOC network rather than the city's own domain, and these are dramatically higher-yield than city.ca pages — exactly the CIOC pattern the task predicted. Three CIOC installs were live and query-able with a plain GET request, no JS/Playwright needed (?STerms=basketball&SType=A on a bresults.asp endpoint): peel.cioc.ca (Information Peel — Mississauga/Brampton/Caledon), www.hipinfo.ca (Information Halton — Oakville/Burlington/Milton/Halton Hills; note bare 'hipinfo.ca' without 'www.' times out, but 'https://www.hipinfo.ca/' works), and info-bhn.cioc.ca (Contact Brant — Brantford/County of Brant/Haldimand/Norfolk, found late but very productive: 4 basketball orgs in Brantford alone). Their record pages sometimes HTML-entity-encode emails (e.g. Peel's install) — these are still fully public/visible to any browser, just decoded with Python's html.unescape, not a bot-wall bypass. A fourth CIOC-family site, cc.search211.ca ('Community Connection', covering Simcoe County/Barrie/Central-East Ontario), is a newer WordPress-based 211 portal that needs JS rendering (Playwright) but embeds clean schema.org JSON-LD contact data per listing; its arbitrary-city geocoder appears broken in this environment (every explicit searchLocation query silently fell back to a fixed ~25km radius around Collingwood), which capped how much of its wider catchment area (Innisfil, Bradford West Gwillimbury, Orillia) could be reached this way — those three were covered instead via each town's own municipal page or general search. Many other regional OpenCIOC domains once listed in the OpenCIOC project's own site directory (york.cioc.ca, durham.cioc.ca, regionofwaterloo.cioc.ca, niagara.cioc.ca, communitylinks.cioc.ca [Guelph], easternontario.cioc.ca, infomarkham.cioc.ca, southsimcoecic.cioc.ca, orillia.cioc.ca, simcoecounty.cioc.ca, infobarrie.cioc.ca) have been DECOMMISSIONED and now either redirect to the generic cioc.ca homepage or show a migration notice pointing to a successor 211 platform (durham.cioc.ca → durham.211central.ca/211central.ca; the Simcoe-family sites → cc.search211.ca).

SECOND PATTERN: a real number of small/mid-size municipalities (Mississauga, Aurora, Georgina, Newmarket, King Township, Pickering, Whitby, Clarington, Brock, Scugog, Cornwall [dead now], Cambridge [dead now]) publish their OWN plain-HTML 'community groups' or 'sport organizations' directory page, exactly matching the task's hypothesis — but for basketball specifically these directories are frequently EMPTY even when comprehensive for every other sport: Newmarket, King, Pickering, Whitby, Clarington, and Brock each list dozens of hockey/soccer/baseball/tennis/etc. clubs with rich contact detail yet zero basketball entries, while real basketball clubs demonstrably serving those same towns (Whitby Saints, Eastern Basketball Association, Oshawa Basketball Association, 360BTG, Clarington Basketball, YNBA in Newmarket) simply aren't registered with their town. Georgina's directory is the clearest example: ~30 richly-detailed clubs across a dozen other sports, explicitly zero for basketball (corroborating an independent prior finding in docs/research/raw/ontario-gap-fill.json). Scugog (Greenbank Basketball) and Peel/Halton/Brant-Norfolk's CIOC installs are the exceptions where basketball IS represented.

THIRD PATTERN: several small-city/regional 'sport council' bodies (Sport Hamilton, Brantford Sports Council, London Sports Council) function as city-recognized umbrella directories even though they're not literally a .ca government domain — Sport Hamilton in particular was the single richest non-CIOC source found (9 real basketball clubs via a JS-rendered SportsEngine site, Playwright-rendered).

DEAD/BLOCKED LINKS: five municipal directory pages that are still indexed by Google/Bing return a true 404 or origin error today — East Gwillimbury's community-contacts page, Uxbridge's community-groups page, Cambridge's clubs-and-organizations page, Cornwall's sports-associations page, and Oshawa's community.oshawa.ca (Cloudflare 526, invalid origin SSL). None were bypassed; all reported as 'dead' per instructions, with the last-known content (where cached/indexed) noted. Ottawa's ottawa.ca sits behind a genuine Incapsula bot-wall on both curl and WebFetch and was reported as 'blocked', not circumvented.

HIGHEST-VALUE NEW CONTACTS (name + phone + email + often a named president/treasurer): Brampton Minor Basketball Association, Caledon Cougars Basketball Association, Milton Stags Youth Basketball, Milton Men's Basketball, Burlington Basketball, Chatham-Kent Wildcats Basketball (13 named executives/coaches), Norfolk Youth Basketball Association, Brantford's 3 CYO/Briers clubs, Hamilton Basketball Association, and Kitchener-Waterloo Youth Basketball Association.

CAUTION FLAGGED: two apparent basketball-club search hits were confirmed to be NAME COLLISIONS with same-named organizations in the US (a 'West Bradford Youth Athletics' in Downingtown, Pennsylvania — not Bradford West Gwillimbury, ON; and a 'North Bay Basketball Academy' in Marin/Sonoma County, California — not North Bay, ON) and were correctly excluded rather than miscounted.
